## Research for better educational decisions

I am Professor of Special Education at the University of Münster, Germany. My research focuses on *data-based instruction*, *single-case experimental methods*, *dynamic assessment*, and the social and emotional dimensions of *inclusive education*. I study how assessment can support better decisions in schools and develop open tools that make analysis easier.
